native_failure.excerpt_scope: Exact first failure section from decoded native job logs, ending at queue binary summary. The job logs repeat this section in the final Bazel log tail; it is not counted as a second execution.

root_cause_scope.source_contract: schedule_idle_dispatch registers a coalesced wake, spawns a task and returns. That task waits for the captured Core completion barrier before dispatch/settlement. on_thread_idle completion is not queue completion.
root_cause_scope.defect: The tests asserted a durable empty queue immediately after scheduling asynchronous work; the old raw TurnComplete receipt also did not retire its completion owner.

root_cause_scope.source_contract: run_owned_dispatch releases only the exact lease on typed RejectedByHook; other admission errors or panics keep an uncertain owner fence.
root_cause_scope.defect: The test called a deliberate hook rejection an ambiguous Core error. Typed definitive rejection correctly called release, contradicting its old fixture.

changes.scope: Three existing tests plus Op import and support-module registration.
ambiguous_case: Use the existing held persistence hook and wait for its entered marker in the owned home.
Flush/read the rollout and require zero matching durable client messages; require zero HTTP requests while the hook is held.
Preserve the first competing-owner DispatchInProgress assertion after the existing 400ms expiry check for the 250ms test lease.
Require owner_start still pending, then send the real public Op::Interrupt.
Require CoreSubmissionError with CodexErrorDetails::InternalAgentDied, the conversion of TaskEndedBeforePersistence. A generic Core error cannot pass.
Observe TurnAborted and await its completion barrier; flush/read again and require zero persisted matching client messages.
Preserve release_count == 0, the identical durable queue row, no HTTP request, and the second competing-owner DispatchInProgress assertion after lease expiry.
Remove the second redundant 400ms sleep; no new fixed delay was added.
asynchronous_cases: Retain the returned ResponseMock in the resumed case and assert its single actual model request contains queued while unloaded.
Assert the intended staged queue exists before emitting idle (two duplicate rows or the exact queued row).
Receive TurnComplete with its completion handle and await actual owner retirement.
Wait for at least one matching-thread ThreadQueueChanged event and an actual empty durable queue, then retain the original explicit empty-queue assertion.
Preserve duplicate case assertions: exactly one model request and one durable client message.

contract: QueueSettlementSink binds to one ThreadId and ignores changes for other threads.
wait_for_empty requires a matching event plus a successful durable queue read; errors propagate.
Register Notified before checking the predicate, preventing a lost transition between the read and await.
Use bounded 10s timeouts and explicit completion/notification waits; no polling sleeps, skips, assertions removed or production API added.
